rows.note: A class implementing Builder.orderBy(String) with orderBy(Object) returning the class type: chained calls on the class type bind the class methods, not the interface declarations.

A private inner class extends an inner type inherited from the enclosing class's superclass by its simple name and implements an interface through the inherited method.
A user Iterable<Object> cast to Iterable<SObject> succeeds and iterates.
for-each over an interface that extends an interface that extends Iterable<Object>.
override Integer hashCode() { return super.hashCode(); } on a class with no superclass.
